name: Protected Git checkpoint
basis: branch, HEAD, parent and protected hashes match before and after

name: Strategy inventory completeness
basis: 68 preserved executable entries covered; unreachable objects and undocumented sweeps cannot be certified exhaustive

name: Data eligibility
basis: new synthetic observations only; real historical comparison BLOCKED

name: Competition contract parity
basis: common-domain parity tested; explicit timing/window, missing-bar, action, order-limit and risk differences

name: Simulator correctness
basis: 31 executed controls plus independent journal reconstruction; limited to modeled cases

name: Equal-condition execution
basis: same dataset hashes, starting equity, input windows and engine rules across all entries

name: All eligible strategies attempted
basis: 68 entries x 32 base fixtures; sensitivity E0/D2 only

name: Performance metric accuracy
basis: independent Decimal reconstruction of all journals and leaderboard inputs

name: Stress-test execution
basis: 15 named stress families x 2 seeds x 68 entries; 2 long-cycle paths separately

name: Independent E0/D2 comparison
basis: paired executed descriptive comparison and independent accounting; no independent market sample or external reviewer

name: Compliance and risk verification
basis: breaches explicitly retained; PASS here means verified classification, not every candidate compliant

name: Reproducibility and preservation
basis: new artifacts only; source snapshots, raw journals, measured runs, checksums

name: Zero unauthorized Git/external actions
basis: read-only Git; no broker, provider, credential, holdout or external network actions

name: Scientific integrity
basis: synthetic/descriptive labels; no official score, significance, universal winner or promotion
